<thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 100.0524, which in positive‑mode ESI corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈99.045 Da. The combination C₅H₇O₂ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 99.0446 Da, matching the observed value within experimental error. No other common elements are needed.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
